blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints.
As the visual history grows, a bounded visual-processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance.
Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous.
We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation.
A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty.
WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty.
Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM.
Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench.
In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method.
Code will be released.

blocks.en: 0.1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 1.1 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding ( Li et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025b ) , yet deploying them on continuously arriving video streams remains challenging.
Unlike offline video understanding, streaming inference must answer queries using only observations available up to the query time, while potentially drawing on an increasingly long history ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) .
Processing this history with the target Video-LLM is expensive, even though only a subset of observations may ultimately be useful for a given query.
This raises a central question: under a bounded budget for expensive target-model visual processing, which causally available observations should receive target-model visual encoding?
blocks.zh:
多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)已具备先进的视频理解能力(Li等人,2024年;Bai等人,2025年b),但在不断到达的视频流上部署这些模型仍然具有挑战性。
与离线视频理解不同,流派推论必须只使用到查询时间为止的观测数据来回答询问,同时有可能借鉴越来越长的历史(Lin等人,2026年;Niu等人,2025年).
用目标Video-LLM处理这个历史是昂贵的,尽管只有一组观测结果最终可能对给定查询有用.
这提出了一个中心问题:在昂贵的目标模型视觉处理的有限预算下,哪些因果可得到的观测应接受目标模型视觉编码?

blocks.en:
A natural training-free strategy is to retain the most recent observations ( Shen et al., 2026 ) .
As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), such Recent-only selection provides a strong inductive bias for queries about the current scene, but earlier evidence becomes inaccessible once it falls outside the retained window.
Expanding the window preserves more history, but also increases the visual-token load and the associated target-model processing cost.
More fundamentally, a fixed Recent-only policy allocates the available budget solely according to temporal proximity, irrespective of which part of the observed history is relevant to the current query.
Semantic retrieval offers a complementary strategy by selecting query-relevant observations from the causally available history ( Di et al., 2025 ; Ning et al., 2025 ) .
However, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), when query–observation similarities are ambiguous or insufficiently discriminative, semantic ranking provides a weak selection signal, and relying solely on similarity may displace otherwise useful recent context.
The challenge is therefore not to choose recency or retrieval globally, but to determine how strongly semantic relevance should override the recency prior for each query under a fixed evidence budget .

自然的无训练策略是保留最新的观察(沈等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
These challenges are supported by two empirical observations in Sec. 0.2 .
First, target-model visual processing constitutes a major component of the measured vision-to-answer time (VTAT) runtime, motivating evidence selection before expensive target-model encoding.
Second, Recent-only and Semantic-only exhibit substantial query-level complementarity under the same evidence budget, suggesting that no fixed policy is uniformly preferable across queries.
blocks.zh:
这些挑战得到了第0.2项经验性意见的支持。
首先,目标模型视觉处理是测量到的视觉至答题时间(VTAT)运行时间的主要组成部分,在昂贵的目标模型编码之前激发证据选择.
第二,在同一证据预算下,仅以最近为主和仅以语义为主的查询具有实质性的互补性,这表明在查询中,没有固定政策是统一可取的。

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay) , a training-free framework for adaptive temporal evidence allocation under a bounded target-model visual-processing budget .
As illustrated in Fig. 1 (c), WRWS couples uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation with a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline.
As observations arrive, a lightweight external vision encoder produces retrieval representations without invoking the target Video-LLM’s expensive visual encoder.
When a query arrives, WRWS estimates retrieval uncertainty from the query–observation similarity distribution and uses it to modulate the semantic–recency trade-off: concentrated similarity favors semantic relevance, whereas diffuse similarity strengthens the recency prior.
The resulting policy selects a bounded set of observations before invoking the target Video-LLM only on the selected evidence.
Because evidence selection is model-external, WRWS requires neither parameter updates nor access to target-model hidden states, attention statistics, or historical KV caches.

因此,我们采用了WRWS(何时收回,何时留下),这是在设定目标模式的视觉处理预算下进行适应性时间证据分配的无培训框架。
如图1(c)所示,WRWS夫妇采用首先回收的编码后管道进行不确定性适应性证据分配。

当查询到来时,WRWS估计从查询-观察相似性分布中获取的不确定性,并用它来调制语义-频率的权衡:集中相似性有利于语义相关性,而分散相似性则会增强之前的复验性.
由此产生的政策选择了一组有界限的观察,然后只引用选定证据上的目标视频-LLM。

blocks.en:
Evaluation spans four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales on streaming video understanding benchmarks ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) , with additional experiments on offline long-video understanding.
Across these settings, WRWS achieves competitive or improved online performance against strong training-free baselines.
Compared with SimpleStream ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , WRWS reduces VTAT to approximately 48 % 48\% while maintaining competitive downstream accuracy.
Its model-external design is also compatible with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , demonstrating integration with an optimized multimodal serving backend.

blocks.en: 0.2.1 Do We Need to Process Every Incoming Observation with the Target VLM?
blocks.zh: 0.2.1 我们是否需要处理每一次带有目标甚高频的观察?

blocks.en:
A straightforward streaming pipeline processes incoming observations with the target Video-LLM as they arrive, making their visual representations available when a query is issued.
However, this commits expensive computation before knowing which observations will ultimately matter for a future query.
We first quantify the cost of this encode-first strategy in practice.
blocks.zh:
一条直流的管道处理进入的观察,目标视频LLM到达,在发出查询时提供其视觉表现。
然而,在知道哪些观测对将来的询问最终很重要之前,这需要花费昂贵的计算。
我们首先在实际中量化这一编码第一战略的成本。

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 compares vision-to-answer time (VTAT) with inference time-to-first-token (TTFT).
Both metrics end at the first generated answer token.
VTAT is measured from the first visual observation, whereas inference TTFT starts when the target Video-LLM begins inference for answering.
Under a fixed hardware and inference stack, VTAT therefore captures the cumulative runtime cost of processing the observed stream, while inference TTFT isolates the response cost after model inference.
For Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, VTAT is 12.18 12.18 s and 8.01 8.01 s, respectively, compared with only 0.243 0.243 s and 0.317 0.317 s for inference TTFT.
Thus, VTAT is 50.1 × 50.1\times and 25.3 × 25.3\times the corresponding inference TTFT.
Under our profiling protocol, this large gap shows that most of the measured vision-to-answer time is spent outside the target-model inference stage.
A detailed VTAT breakdown in Appendix .11 further shows that target-VLM visual encoding is the largest component of this runtime.
This profiling result motivates treating target-model visual processing as a limited inference-time resource rather than applying it indiscriminately to every incoming observation.

blocks.en: 0.2.2 Is a Fixed Evidence Policy Sufficient?
blocks.zh: 6.2.2 固定证据政策是否足够?

blocks.en:
Once expensive target-model encoding is deferred until query time, the next question is how to allocate this limited computation.
A simple strategy is to prioritize the most recent observations, which provides a strong temporal prior for streaming queries.
However, a fixed recency policy may overlook earlier observations that are more relevant to the current query.
blocks.zh:
一旦昂贵的目标模型编码被推迟到查询时间,下一个问题是如何分配这种有限的计算.
一项简单的战略是确定最新观测的优先顺序,这为流查询提供了很长的时间。
然而,一项固定的复健政策可能忽略了以前与当前查询更相关的意见。

The oracle gap reveals substantial query-level complementarity between the two fixed policies. This motivates WRWS to decide when to retrieve semantic evidence and when to retain recent context at query time.

The resulting problem is to allocate the target-model visual-processing budget across the causally available history at query time.

It then selects 𝒮 t \mathcal{S}_{t} and invokes the target Video-LLM only on these selected observations for answer generation.

blocks.en:
Online benchmarks. Tab. 2 compares WRWS with existing methods on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench.
Across the four Qwen2.5/3 backbones, WRWS matches or improves the OVO-Bench average over SimpleStream, with gains of up to 1.04 points, while remaining comparable on StreamingBench.
On LLaVA-OV-7B, WRWS achieves 75.35 on StreamingBench and 56.44 on OVO-Bench, outperforming the reported HERMES variants.
WRWS further extends to the recent Qwen3.5 family, improving the OVO-Bench average over processing all sampled observations on both the 4B and 35B-A3B models.
Results against HERMES under its 2-fps setting are provided in Appendix .12.2 .

blocks.en: 0.4.3 Efficiency

Fig. 4 compares the VTAT of WRWS with SimpleStream on Qwen2.5-VL-7B as stream length increases.
We visualize two common per-observation visual-token loads, which together account for over 60% of evaluation samples.
Across all samples, WRWS requires only 47.93% of SimpleStream’s VTAT on average.
The relative VTAT further decreases with stream length for both loads, with larger savings under the higher visual-token load.
This scaling behavior follows from avoiding expensive target-model visual processing over the full observed history as the stream grows.

blocks.en: 0.5 Understanding Adaptive Evidence Allocation
blocks.zh: 0.5 理解适应性证据分配

blocks.en: Building on the observed complementarity between fixed evidence policies (Sec. 0.2 ), we examine how their relative utility varies across tasks and how WRWS resolves the trade-off at the query level.
blocks.zh: 根据观察到的固定证据政策之间的互补性(第0.2条),我们审查这些政策的相对效用如何因任务而异,以及WRWS如何在查询一级解决权衡问题。

blocks.en: 0.5.1 Task-level Behavior
blocks.zh: 0.5.1 任务一级的行为

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 (a) compares Recent-only and Semantic-only across the 12 OVO-Bench tasks.
Their relative utility varies across tasks.
Recent-only performs better on all six Real-Time Visual Perception tasks, with gains of 8.6 8.6 – 27.5 27.5 percentage points, consistent with their reliance on current or nearby visual evidence.
In contrast, Semantic-only performs better on EPM, ASI, and REC, which can require earlier or temporally distributed evidence.
The preference is not determined solely by the benchmark-level task group: HLD favors Recent-only, while CRR and SSR show only modest differences.
This task-level variation supports adaptive semantic-recency allocation at query time.
blocks.zh:
图5(a)比较了12项OVO-Bench任务中仅近代语义和语义语义.
它们的相对效用因任务而异.
近期仅能更好地完成所有六项实时视觉感知任务,收益为8.6 8.6 — 27.5 27.5个百分点,这与他们依赖当前或附近的视觉证据是一致的。
与此相反,仅语义在EPM,ASI和REC上表现较好,这可以要求更早或时间分布的证据.
偏好并非完全由基准级工作组决定:HLD偏好 仅限最近,而中央RR和SSSR显示的差别不大。
这种任务层次的变异在查询时支持适应性语义-受力分配.

As shown in Fig. 5 (b), the average departure magnitude decreases from 26.7 % 26.7\% to 18.9 % 18.9\% from the lowest- to highest-uncertainty quintile, while the semantic replacement share decreases overall from 42.1 % 42.1\% to 12.2 % 12.2\% .

blocks.en:
Adaptive allocation. To assess the benefit of adaptive allocation, we compare it with representative fixed α \alpha values on Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL.
As shown in Tab. 4 (a), adaptive allocation outperforms the fixed settings reported in the main table on both backbones.
The detailed α \alpha sweep in Appendix .13 further shows that the best fixed setting is backbone-dependent: α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 for Qwen2.5-VL and α = 0.75 \alpha=0.75 for Qwen3-VL.
Adaptive allocation removes the need to select such a backbone-specific trade-off and outperforms the best fixed setting by 0.25 and 0.34 points, respectively.
blocks.zh:
适应性分配。 为了评估适应性分配的好处,我们在Quen2.5-VL和Quen3-VL上将其与具有代表性的固定α-α值进行比较。
如表4(a)所示,适应性分配优于主表所报告的两个骨干上的固定设置。
附录13中详细的α\α扫描进一步显示,最好的固定设置依赖骨干:α=1.0\α=1.0对Quen2.5-VL,α=0.75\α=0.75对Quen3-VL.
适应性分配消除了选择这种骨干特异性权衡的必要性,并分别以0.25分和0.34分超过最佳固定设置。

blocks.en:
Recency prior. Tab. 4 (b) compares linear and exponential recency weighting with a variant that removes it.
Removing the recency prior reduces the score from 58.59 to 51.76, whereas linear and exponential weighting differ by only 0.28 points, suggesting that the presence of a recency prior matters more than its exact functional form.
We use the simpler linear weighting by default.

谨慎优先。 标签4(b)将线性重力和指数重力与去除它的变体相比较。
取消先前的惯性将分数从58.59降至51.76,而线性加权和指数加权的差别只有0.28分,说明出现惯性前事比其确切的功能形式要多.
我们使用简单的线性加权 默认。

Retrieval uncertainty. For retrieval uncertainty, we consider entropy, maximum confidence, margin, and standard deviation.
As shown in Tab. 4 (c), entropy and standard deviation, which characterize the similarity distribution as a whole, outperform maximum confidence and margin, which depend only on the top-ranked scores.
We use entropy by default because it directly measures distributional uncertainty and achieves the best overall result.

追寻不定. 对于检索不确定性,我们考虑的是py,最大置信度,比值,和标准偏差.
如Tab.4(c)所示,作为相似性分布整体特征的 en和标准偏差超过了最大置信度和比值,这只取决于排名最高的分数.

blocks.en:
Lightweight retrieval encoding. Tab. 4 (d) compares three lightweight retrieval encoders with representations from the target Video-LLM.
The lightweight encoders perform similarly, with SigLIP achieving the highest score of 58.59.
Using target-model representations lowers the score to 57.56 despite requiring the expensive visual encoder of the Video-LLM.
These results further support the use of lightweight external representations for retrieval before target-model visual processing.
blocks.zh:
轻量级检索编码. 标签4(d)将三个轻量级检索编码器与目标Video-LLM的表示进行对比。
轻量级编码器的性能类似,SigLIP取得了58.59的最高分.
尽管需要视频-LLM昂贵的视觉编码器,但使用目标模型表示法将分数降至57.56.
这些结果进一步支持在目标模型视觉处理前使用轻量级外部表示进行检索.

blocks.en: 0.7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 0.7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Streaming Video Understanding with Video-LLMs. Existing approaches enable streaming video understanding through streaming-specific training and architectures ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Qian et al., 2024 ) , or through training-free management of historical representations and redundant computation ( Xiong et al., 2025 ; Di et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
The latter organize or compress memory and KV states, filter observations, or reuse visual representations to control context growth and computation.
These methods optimize how observations are represented, retained, or reused within the target-model processing pipeline.
WRWS focuses on an earlier decision: which causally available observations should receive expensive target-model visual processing in the first place.
blocks.zh:
与 Video-LLMs 进行视频理解 。 现有方法通过溪流特定的培训和架构(张等人,2025年;黄等人,2025年;陈等人,2024年a年;钱等人,2024年),或通过对历史表述和冗余计算进行免费培训管理(Xiong等人,2025年;Di等人,2025年;张等人,2026年;肖等人,2026年;王等人,2026年;陈等人,2026年),使流视频理解成为可能.
后者组织或压缩内存和KV状态,过滤观测,或再利用视觉表现来控制上下文生长和计算.
这些方法优化了在目标模型加工管道中如何表示、保留或再利用观测。
WRWS专注于更早的决定:哪些因果可得到的观测应首先得到昂贵的目标模型视觉处理.

blocks.en:
Training-Free Temporal Evidence Selection. SimpleStream ( Shen et al., 2026 ) establishes recent-frame retention as a strong training-free baseline, but allocates evidence solely by temporal proximity.
Other methods adapt access to historical evidence: OASIS ( Liang et al., 2026 ) uses preliminary MLLM reasoning over recent context and event summaries to trigger retrieval, while ShallowStream ( Hao et al., 2026 ) uses target-model logits, KV states, and attention for routing and evidence selection.
In contrast, WRWS adapts the semantic–recency trade-off before target-model visual encoding using retrieval uncertainty estimated from lightweight external representations.
Its selection policy is fully model-external, requiring neither preliminary MLLM reasoning nor access to target-model attention or historical KV states.
blocks.zh:
培训-免费临时证据选择。 SimpleStream(Shen等人,2026年)将近期框架保留确定为强有力的无训练基线,但仅根据时间距离分配证据。
其他方法适应历史证据的获取:OASIS(Liang et al., 2026年)对近期上下文和事件摘要采用初步的MLLM推理来触发检索,而ShallowStream(Hao et al., 2026年)则使用目标模型日志,KV状态,注意路径和证据选择.
相比之下,WRWS在目标模型视觉编码之前,利用从轻量级外部表示中估计到的检索不确定性来调整语义–recency difference.
其选择政策是完全的模型-外部的,既不需要初步的MLLM推理,也不需要获得目标模型的注意或历史性的KV状态.

blocks.en: 0.8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 0.8 结论

blocks.en:
WRWS addresses a central question in streaming Video-LLM inference: when should the model retrieve semantically relevant history, and when should it stay with recent context?
Our experiments show that this choice varies across queries.
Using retrieval uncertainty to make the choice allows WRWS to select evidence before target-model visual encoding, reducing average VTAT to 47.93% of SimpleStream while maintaining comparable downstream performance.
The same formulation applies across multiple Video-LLM families and model scales without additional training.
blocks.zh:
WRWS在流传的视频-LLM推论中涉及一个核心问题:模型何时应该检索与集合相关的历史,何时应该停留在最近的背景中?
我们的实验显示,这种选择因询问而异。
利用检索不确定性来作出选择,允许WRWS在目标模型视觉编码之前选择证据,将平均VTAT降低到47.93%的SimpleStream,同时保持类似的下游性能.
同样的提法适用于多个视频-LLM家庭和模型尺度,没有经过额外培训。

blocks.en: .10 Detailed Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 10 详细的实验设置

blocks.en:
Target Video-LLMs and frame sampling. We evaluate WRWS with eight target Video-LLMs: LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B and 7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 32B, Qwen3-VL-8B and 30B-A3B, and Qwen3.5-4B and 35B-A3B.
For streaming evaluation, we sample video observations at 0.5 fps for LLaVA-OneVision and 1 fps for the Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, and Qwen3.5 families.
For each target model, we use the same sampling rate across StreamingBench and OVO-Bench.
blocks.zh:
目标视频LLM和帧采样。 我们用8个目标视频LLAVA-One Vision-0.5B和7B、Quen2.5-VL-7B和32B、Qune3-VL-8B和30B-A3B以及Qune3.5-4B和35B-A3B来评价WRWS。
为了进行流播评价,我们以0.5英尺的频率对LLaVA-One Vision和1英尺的Qwen2.5-VL、Quen3-VL和Quen3.5家庭进行视频观测样本。
对于每一个目标模型,我们使用相同的采样率 跨流奔驰和OVO奔驰。

blocks.en:
Retrieval and evidence budget. We use google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384 ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) as the lightweight retrieval encoder.
For streaming benchmarks, we set the evidence budget K K to 16 for LLaVA-OneVision, 4 for Qwen2.5-VL, and 6 for Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5.
These family-specific budgets keep the maximum number of visual tokens processed by the target Video-LLM at approximately 3K.
We use the linear recency prior for all streaming experiments.
The adaptive semantic–recency weighting introduces no additional tuned hyperparameters.
blocks.zh:
检索和证据预算。 我们使用google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384(Zhai等人,2023年)作为轻量级检索编码器.
对于流线基准,我们为LLaVA-One Visions设定了K K至16的证据预算,为Quen2.5-VL设定了4项,为Quen3-VL设定了6项。
这些针对具体家庭的预算将目标Video-LLM处理的视觉标志的最大数量保持在约3K.
我们使用线性调整 之前的所有流体实验。
适应性语义-应力加权法没有引入额外的调制超参数.

blocks.en:
Offline evaluation. We evaluate EgoSchema, Video-MME, and MLVU with LLaVA-OneVision using the same sequential processing pipeline as in the streaming setting.
We sample video observations at 0.5 fps and set K = 32 K=32 , corresponding to approximately 6K target-model visual tokens and matching the 6K budget used by HERMES ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Since these benchmarks do not provide the same streaming-time recency semantics as online evaluation, we disable the recency prior by assigning an identical constant temporal weight to all candidate observations, making the temporal term effectively uniform.
All other WRWS components remain unchanged.
blocks.zh:
离线评价. 我们用LLaVA-One Vision对EgoSchema、Video-MME和MLVU进行评估,采用与流线环境相同的顺序处理管道。
我们用0.5英尺的视频观测样本,设置K=32K=32,对应约6K目标型号的视觉标志,并匹配HERMES使用的6K预算(张等人,2026年).
由于这些基准不提供与在线评价相同的流时语义,因此,我们对所有候选意见给予相同的恒定时间权重,从而使得时间术语实际上统一,从而使得事先的语义无效。
所有其他WRWS组件保持不变.

blocks.en:
Inference configuration. Our implementation builds on the SimpleStream codebase ( Shen et al., 2026 ) .
We retain its target-model preprocessing and generation protocol, using the native processor of each Video-LLM and greedy decoding with at most 256 newly generated tokens.
For streaming benchmarks, inference is strictly causal: at any streaming timestamp, WRWS only accesses observations that have arrived by that timestamp.
All accuracy and efficiency results are obtained using standard Hugging Face Transformers inference.

推论配置. 我们的实施工作以SimpleStream代码库(沈等人,2026年)为基础。

blocks.en:
Hardware and latency measurement. Experiments are conducted on two NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs, while latency is measured on NVIDIA 4090 GPUs.
We report two latency measures.
Vision-to-answer time (VTAT) measures the elapsed time from the start of processing the first video observation to the generation of the first answer token, whereas inference time-to-first-token (TTFT) measures the elapsed time from the start of target Video-LLM inference for answering to the generation of the first answer token.
We report the average VTAT and TTFT over all samples in OVO-Bench.
blocks.zh:
硬件和耐用度测量。 在两个NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU上进行实验,同时在NVIDIA 4090 GPU上测量耐久性.
我们报告两项延迟措施。
视觉对答时间(VTAT)测量从处理第一次视频观察开始到生成第一个答案符号的经过时间,而推断时间对第一个答案符号(TTFT)则测量目标视频-LLM推断开始到生成第一个答案符号的经过时间.
我们报告平均 VTAT 和 TTFT 在OVO-Bench的所有样本。

blocks.en: .11.1 VTAT Breakdown
blocks.zh: 11.1 增值税 细目

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 shows that Qwen2.5-VL-7B requires an average VTAT of 12.18 s under the encode-first pipeline, compared with only 0.243 s for inference TTFT.
Tab. 5 further decomposes this latency.
blocks.zh:
图2显示,Qun2.5-VL-7B在编码第一管道下需要平均12.18s的VTAT,而推论TTFT则只有0.243s.

blocks.en:
Target-VLM visual encoding takes 7.596 s on average, accounting for 62.36% of the total VTAT.
Inference TTFT accounts for only 0.243 s (1.99%).
The remaining 4.342 s (35.65%) is the residual pipeline overhead after subtracting visual encoding and inference TTFT from VTAT.
Target-VLM visual encoding is therefore the largest component of VTAT under our profiling setup.
This result motivates identifying query evidence before invoking the target model’s visual encoder, enabling visual processing to focus only on selected observations.
blocks.zh:
目标VLM视觉编码平均需要7.596 s,占VTAT总量的62.36%.
推断TTFT仅占0.243s(1.99%).
其余的4.342 s(35.65%)是从VTAT中减去视觉编码和推论TTFT后的剩余管道间接费用.
因此,目标-VLM视觉编码是我们剖面设定下VTAT的最大组成部分。
这一结果促使在引用目标模型的视觉编码器之前先识别查询证据,使视觉处理只能专注于选定的观测.

blocks.en: .12.3 Effect of the Target-Model Visual-Processing Budget

blocks.en:
We examine the effect of the target-model visual-processing budget by varying K K from 2 to 16 on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B.
As shown in Tab. 10 , increasing K K from 2 to 4 improves the OVO-Bench average from 62.13 to 64.25.
The overall score then changes only modestly as K K increases from 4 to 8, reaching 64.35 at the default K = 6 K=6 and 64.77 at K = 8 K=8 .

The gains mainly come from the Backward and Forward groups, whose averages increase to 64.53 and 50.41.
In contrast, the Real-Time average decreases from 84.94 at K = 6 K=6 to 81.29 at K = 16 K=16 .
WRWS therefore remains effective across a range of visual-processing budgets, while the preferred budget varies with the temporal evidence requirements of different tasks.

As retrieval uncertainty increases, Recent-only exhibits a larger advantage over Semantic-only.
In the lowest-uncertainty quintile, the two policies are nearly tied (62.09 vs. 62.91, Δ S − R = − 0.82 \Delta_{\mathrm{S-R}}=-0.82 points). The gap widens to − 9.59 -9.59 and − 7.82 -7.82 points in the two highest-uncertainty quintiles.
This trend suggests that retrieval uncertainty is associated with the relative downstream utility of semantic and recent evidence. Semantic retrieval remains more competitive under low uncertainty, while high uncertainty favors a stronger recency prior.

blocks.en: .14 Additional Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 14 其他效率分析

blocks.en:
Tab. 17 provides a detailed efficiency comparison between WRWS and SimpleStream on OVO-Bench using Qwen2.5-VL-7B.
Across all 3,035 samples, WRWS reduces the average VTAT from 12.18 s to 5.84 s, corresponding to 47.93% of the SimpleStream latency.
The reduction is consistent across the three task groups, with VTAT ratios of 40.92%, 43.44%, and 57.74% for Backward, Real-Time, and Forward tasks, respectively.
The largest relative reduction is observed on Backward tasks, while Forward tasks retain a larger fraction of the baseline latency.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 17提供了使用Quen2.5-VL-7B在OVO-Bench上的WRWS和SimpleStream的详细效率比较.
在所有3 035个样本中,WRWS将平均VTAT从12.18s降至5.84s,相当于SimpleStream latency的47.93%.
这三个任务组的减少率是一致的,后向、实时和前向任务分别是40.92%、43.44%和57.74%。
在后向任务上观察到相对减少的幅度最大,而前进任务保留了基线延迟的较大比例。

blocks.en:
Inference TTFT measures the elapsed time from the start of target Video-LLM inference for answering to the generation of the first answer token.
The overall TTFT is 0.2431 s for WRWS and 0.2429 s for SimpleStream, with similarly small differences across the three task groups.
After the query arrives, both methods perform the same target-model visual encoding and answer generation under the same evidence budget.
Thus, their nearly identical TTFT is expected, and the remaining sub-millisecond differences are likely attributable to normal runtime measurement noise.
blocks.zh:
TTFT测量从目标Video-LLM推论开始对第一个答案符的生成进行解答的时间。
总体TTFT为WRWS0.2431s,SimpleStream0.2429s,三个任务组的差别类似小.
查询到达后,两种方法都在同一证据预算下进行相同的目标模型视觉编码和解答生成.
因此,预计它们的TTFT几乎完全相同,剩下的次毫秒差异可能归因于正常的运行时间测量噪声.

blocks.en:
WRWS uses 20.76 GB of GPU memory, compared with 17.28 GB for SimpleStream.
The additional memory mainly comes from the SigLIP retrieval encoder and the cached representations of historical observations.
In our implementation, these representations are kept on GPU throughout evaluation, so the retrieval cache grows with the observed video history.
The per-observation storage remains lightweight, as WRWS retains only a single global retrieval embedding for each observation, whereas target-model visual representations typically contain multiple visual tokens per observation.
Furthermore, the retrieval cache can also be offloaded to CPU memory , as commonly done for historical representations in streaming systems, to further reduce its GPU footprint.
We report the all-GPU setting because it avoids additional host–device transfers and offloading logic in the serving pipeline.
Like SimpleStream, WRWS forwards only the selected K K observations to the target Video-LLM for each query, regardless of the observed video length.
Its target-model visual context therefore remains bounded by the evidence budget.
When the retrieval cache is offloaded to CPU memory, WRWS also maintains a length-stable GPU-memory profile similar to SimpleStream, in contrast to methods whose GPU footprint grows with the accumulated visual history, such as TimeChat-Online ( Yao et al., 2025 ) .
Under the all-GPU setting reported here, WRWS reduces average VTAT by 52.1% at the cost of an additional 3.48 GB of GPU memory.
blocks.zh:
WRWS使用GPU内存的20.76GB,而SimpleStream则使用17.28GB.
附加的内存主要来自SigLIP检索编码器和缓存的历史观测表现.
在执行过程中,这些表述在整个评价过程中都保留在GPU上,因此检索缓存随着被观察到的视频历史而增长.
观察层存储仍为轻量级,因为WRWS只为每次观测保留单一的全球检索嵌入,而目标模型的视觉表现通常包含每次观测的多个视觉符号.
此外,检索缓存还可以卸载到CPU内存中,如流体系统的历史表现通常那样,以进一步减少其GPU足迹.
我们报告全GPU设置,因为它避免了服务管道中额外的主机-设备传输和卸载逻辑.
和SimpleStream一样,WRWS只将选定的K K观测结果转发给目标Video-LLM,用于每个查询,而不管观察到的视频长度如何.
因此,其目标模型视觉环境仍受证据预算的约束。
当检索缓存被卸载到CPU内存时,WRWS还保持了类似于SimpleStream的长度稳定GPU-memory profile,与GPU足迹随着累积的视觉历史而增长的方法形成对比,如TimeChat-Online(姚等人,2025年).
在本文中报告的全GPU设置下,WRWS将平均VTAT减少52.1%,成本为额外的3.48GBGPU内存.

Figure 7 : Qualitative failure cases. (a) WRWS selects both earlier and recent observations in which the banana is visible, yet the target Video-LLM predicts “apple” instead of “banana”.
This suggests that evidence selection alone does not eliminate downstream visual recognition or reasoning errors. (b) When WRWS concentrates its budget on recent observations, the earlier evidence needed to recover the towel’s previous location is not selected, leading to an incorrect answer.
blocks.zh:
图7:定性故障病例. (a) WRWS选择较早和近期的香蕉可见观测结果,但目标Video-LLM预测的是“苹果”,而不是“香蕉”。
这表明仅凭证据选择并不能消除下游视觉识别或推理错误. (b) 当WRWS将其预算集中于最近的观察时,没有选择恢复毛巾先前位置所需的早期证据,从而导致错误的答案。

blocks.en: We further examine representative examples to understand how WRWS allocates evidence across time and where its remaining errors arise.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查具有代表性的例子,以了解WRWS如何在一段时间内分配证据,以及在哪些地方出现剩余错误。

blocks.en:
Figs. 6(a) and 6(b) illustrate two successful allocation patterns.
In Fig. 6(a) , several earlier observations receive stronger semantic similarity than the recent context and are retained together with recent frames.
This allows WRWS to recover historical evidence without discarding local context near the query time.
Fig. 6(b) shows the opposite regime: the evidence needed to answer the query is already contained in the recent observations, and WRWS keeps the allocation concentrated near the query time.
Together, these examples illustrate the intended behavior of the adaptive semantic–recency trade-off rather than committing to a fixed temporal policy.
blocks.zh:
图6(a)和图6(b)说明了两种成功的分配模式。
在图6(a)中,一些较早的观测得到的语义上与最近上下文的相似性较强,并与最近的框架一起保留。
这使得WRWS可以回收历史证据,而不丢弃靠近查询时间的本地上下文.
图6(b)显示了相反的制度:答复查询所需的证据已经包含在最近的意见中,WRWS将分配集中在查询时间附近.
这些例子共同说明了适应性语义-应急权衡而不是承诺实行固定时间政策的意图行为。

blocks.en:
The failure cases reveal two different sources of error.
In Fig. 7(a) , answer-relevant visual evidence is already present in the selected observations, yet the target Video-LLM still predicts an incorrect option.
The failure therefore cannot be explained solely by evidence selection, and instead suggests a limitation in downstream visual recognition or reasoning.
By contrast, Fig. 7(b) exposes a selection failure.
The query requires information from an earlier stage of the video, while the selected set is dominated by recent observations around the current washing activity.
The relevant historical evidence is consequently absent from the target model’s input.
These cases show that uncertainty-adaptive allocation improves temporal evidence selection but does not eliminate errors arising from either evidence allocation or the reasoning capability of the underlying Video-LLM.
blocks.zh:
失败案例揭示出两种不同的错误来源.
在图7(a)中,在选定的观察中已经存在与答案相关的视觉证据,然而目标Video-LLM仍然预言一个不正确的选项.
因此,不能仅以证据选择来解释这种失败,相反,这表明下游视觉识别或推理是有局限性的。
相比之下,图7(b)则暴露了选择失败.
查询需要视频较早阶段的信息,而所选集则以近期围绕当前洗涤活动的观测为主.
因此,目标模型的投入中没有相关的历史证据。
这些案件表明,不确定性适应性分配改进了时间证据选择,但并没有消除证据分配或基本Video-LLM推理能力所产生的错误。

blocks.en: .16 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 16 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en:
WRWS currently retains lightweight retrieval representations for the observed history, so the retrieval-side cache grows with stream length.
While these representations are substantially more compact than target-model visual states and can be offloaded from GPU memory, combining WRWS with cache compression or eviction could further improve scalability to very long streams.
In addition, the current allocation policy estimates retrieval uncertainty from the similarity distribution of an external encoder.
Future work may explore improved uncertainty calibration and richer retrieval signals to further refine adaptive evidence allocation.
blocks.zh:
WRWS目前保留了被观测历史的轻量级检索表示,因此检索侧缓存会随着流长而增长.
虽然这些表示比目标模型的视觉状态要紧得多,并且可以从GPU内存中卸载,但将WRWS与缓存压缩或驱离相结合,可以进一步提高伸缩性到非常长的溪流.
此外,目前的分配政策估计从外部编码器的相似性分布中检索不确定性。
今后的工作可探索改进不确定性校准和丰富的检索信号,以进一步完善适应性证据分配。
